title: Rifampicin and its derivatives: stability, disposition, and affinity towards pregnane X receptor employing 2D and 3D primary human hepatocytes.
authors: Smutny, Tomas; Smutna, Lucie; Lochman, Lukas; Kamaraj, Rajamanikkam; Kucera, Radim; Pavek, Petr
one_liner_zh: 该文研究利福平及其衍生物在肝细胞中的稳定性、代谢及对PXR核受体的激活，仅含少量配体-受体结合模拟，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Rifampicin is a model ligand of the pregnane X receptor (PXR), the nuclear receptor involved in the regulation of cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4). Rifampicin forms several degradation products and metabolites of which 25-desacetylrifampicin is the most abundant in vivo. Here, we aimed to study both the stability and metabolism of rifampicin in media and 2D and 3D primary human hepatocytes (PHHs). Additionally, we analyzed interactions of rifampicin derivatives with PXR. We described that rifampicin gradually degrades by more than 50 % in the medium partly into quinone over 72 h. We observed 25-desacetylrifampicin in 2D PHHs but not in 3D PHHs. Contrary, rifampicin was converted into quinone in a one-direction process in media of 3D PHHs. The potency of rifampicin and its derivatives to activate human PXR was arranged as follows: 3-formylrifamycin SV > rifampicin quinone > rifampicin > rifampicin N-oxide > 25-desacetylrifampicin, respectively, but none activates mouse and rat PXR. The binding differences between rifampicin and 25-desacetylrifampicin were modeled in silico. Finally, we showed that overexpressed uptake organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1 (OATP1B1) potentiated activation of PXR by rifampicin and rifampicin quinone, but overexpressed efflux multidrug resistance protein 1 (MDR1) decreased PXR activation by all derivatives.
abstract_zh: 利福平是孕烷X受体（PXR）的模式配体，该核受体参与细胞色素P450 3A4（CYP3A4）的调控。利福平形成多种降解产物和代谢物，其中25-去乙酰利福平在体内最为丰富。本研究旨在探讨利福平在培养基及二维和三维原代人肝细胞（PHHs）中的稳定性与代谢情况。此外，我们分析了利福平衍生物与PXR的相互作用。我们观察到，利福平在培养基中72小时内逐渐降解超过50%，部分转化为醌。在二维PHHs中检测到25-去乙酰利福平，但在三维PHHs中未检测到。相反，在三维PHHs的培养基中，利福平以单向过程转化为醌。利福平及其衍生物激活人PXR的效力排序如下：3-甲酰利福霉素SV > 利福平醌 > 利福平 > 利福平N-氧化物 > 25-去乙酰利福平，但均不激活小鼠和大鼠PXR。利福平与25-去乙酰利福平之间的结合差异通过计算机模拟建模。最后，我们证明过表达的摄取型有机阴离子转运多肽1B1（OATP1B1）增强了利福平和利福平醌对PXR的激活，而过表达的外排型多药耐药蛋白1（MDR1）则降低了所有衍生物对PXR的激活。
